znA_Mf_8_l0.tags: nepal flash flood; nepal flood footage; nepal flood; nepal flood explained; nepal flood video; what caused nepal flood; nepal landslide; flash flood explained; nepal floods; flood in nepal; nepal flood disaster; nepal disaster; nepal flash floods; himalayan floods; nepal flood news; flash flood; Stormora
znA_Mf_8_l0.transcript: It had barely rained. No heavy rain anywhere upstream, the hydrology department says. Only light showers the day before. And yet, on the morning of October 11th, the Budhi Gandaki in Nepal's Gorkha district surged nearly 5 m in about 2 hours, the height of a two-story house, to 8.4 m on the gauge at Arughat, past the 5-m danger line. Then the sensor itself was swept away. So, where did the water come from? Stay with this valley and you will see what came down it and why Nepal keeps getting hit. The story starts high in the valley near the border with Tibet. Around 4:00 in the morning, people woke to a roar. Some told reporters the river stopped, then surged, then stopped again. They ran uphill in the dark. Beside one side stream stood four sheep sheds. They were swept away with around 150 animals, according to police. At least five people who were there were still missing that night, police said. The only bridge between two villages went with the water. Seventeen trekkers in one village and 40 in another waited to be picked up. All safe. Here is what the hydrology department found on the satellite images. A fresh landslide on a tributary high in the valley, which appears to have come down overnight. Picture a wall of rock and earth dropped across a narrow stream. The water backs up behind it. Then the wall gives way. The army, the disaster authority, and a regional mountain institute all say that is the likely sequence. The head of the disaster authority adds it may have happened more than once in the night. All of it is preliminary. A team with a drone and a geologist was sent out that day. Hold that picture. The cork and the lake. It is the key to this story. Downstream, the flood reached the trekking villages on the Manaslu trail. At about half past 8:00, an army helicopter was lifting six people out of a village where nine houses had gone into the river. Officials said the residents were safe, but more houses were cut off, and more than 100 foreign trekkers were stranded along the trail, all reported safe. Further down, the flood hit a hydropower plant still under construction, taking the main camp and some of the machinery. 18 workers got out after villagers raised the alarm, according to local reports. >> [screaming] >> Then the bridges went. A bridge where a side stream meets the river dropped into the water. A suspension bridge higher up and an old footbridge further up the valley swept away. At Arughat, the main bridge between Gorkha and the next district lost its 22 meter concrete span. The 60 meter truss still stands and the roads department is planning a temporary bridge. Two telecom towers and about 50 power poles are damaged and the villages up the valley have no electricity. At Arughat, though, the warning arrived before the water. The hydrology department was told of the blockage at about 6:00 in the morning, the disaster authority 20 minutes later, and at 6:40 text alerts went out to phones along the river. Eight riverside settlements were asked to move and the market at Arughat was emptied. The flood arrived at around 8:00. The head of the disaster authority says those messages are why people were already on higher ground. The surge crossed into the next district and reached the larger river at 9:51 in the morning. Six districts went on alert. By evening, the hydrology department said the wave had passed and the main river to the south was already falling. In its evening update at 13:18 UTC, the disaster authority counted 45 houses completely damaged and 27 partly damaged and 52 people rescued. An hour later, its records still showed at least five people missing near the upper valley and no lives lost confirmed. Step back and a pattern appears. 46 days earlier on August 26th, a mudflow came down a valley to the east into the same river system. By October 11th, more than 1,400 bodies had been recovered and police were still searching for more than 4,700 people. Five weeks earlier, a smaller flood in the same municipality took four houses and a footbridge. In April 2024, an avalanche into a glacial lake under Manaslu sent a surge down this very river. Three floods on this river in 30 months and the biggest of all a few valleys to the east. That is not bad luck. That is a system. >> Oh my >> Oh my god. >> Oh my god. >> Why does Nepal keep getting hit? Not for one reason. For seven and they stack. Three are built into the place itself. The shape of the land, the monsoon and the forces still pushing these mountains up. One is a shock the country has not recovered from. Two are the machines that turn a landslide or a glacier into a wall of water. And the last one is us. Roads and camps cut into slopes that were never stable. Start with the ground. From the lowlands on the Indian border to the summit of Manaslu is about 150 km in a straight line, a 2-hour drive on a highway. In that distance, the land climbs from about 100 m to more than 8,000. In one stretch, it gains 3 km of height in 20. At the steepest point, it climbs 1.3 km in a single kilometer. Four Eiffel Towers stacked up. Over a distance you could walk in 12 minutes. About 83% of Nepal is mountain. Rain that falls up there has nowhere to slow down. It drops straight into gorges, and the gorges are narrow. When scientists studied a flood on another Nepali river in 2012, NASA's Earth Observatory reported that the valley falls 6,100 m in about 40 km, and that a gorge that tight is easy to block. That is the first ingredient. A staircase of rock where one landslide can cork a river in minutes. The second ingredient is the water. And it does not arrive evenly. Nepal gets roughly 3/4 to 4/5 of its rain in 4 months, June to September, the summer monsoon. Over Gorkha, that is about 2,200 mm in those 4 months, out of about 2,700 for the year, according to a long-term reanalysis. July alone brings around 800 mm. If none of it drained away, July's rain would stand above your knee across the whole landscape. By September, the soil is full. It cannot take any more. And it is wildly uneven. In the 2022 monsoon, a station on the wet side of the Annapurna range recorded 4,200 mm. A station in the rain shadow behind it recorded 156, 27 times less in the same season. A study of 98 stations found almost every extreme rain event in Nepal falls in the monsoon, peaking in July. But remember October 11th, barely any rain. The monsoon loads the slopes. Something else pulls the trigger. That something is the mountain itself. The Himalaya is still being built. India is pushing north into Asia at about 45 mm a year, about as fast as your fingernails grow, according to the US Geological Survey. Roughly 18 mm of that goes into lifting the range. Under Nepal, the whole mountain belt rides on one great fault, the main Himalayan thrust, a gently sloping surface 5 to 15 km down, which steepens into a ramp about 100 km north of the foothills. Nepal's largest earthquakes in 1934 and 2015 broke along that surface. At the mountain front, the rock rises as fast as 1 and 1/2 cm a year, and the crust thickens from 40 km under the plains to 70 under Tibet. Rock pushed up that fast gets crushed, folded, and weathered. Nepalese geologists call it soft and fragile. So, every slope in Nepal is a slope waiting for a reason to fall. In April 2015, it got one. On April 25th, 2015, a magnitude 7.8 earthquake broke on that fault. Its epicenter was in Gorkha district, only 8 km deep and about 22 km from the town of Arughat, where the gauge was swept away on October 11th. Close to 9,000 lives were lost. And the ground let go. At least 25,000 landslides, by one survey. Count them one per second, and you would still be counting 7 hours later. More than half of that debris landed directly in stream channels. Take one village in this same valley. In the 2015 quake, about 70% of its homes were destroyed, and landslides and collapsing buildings claimed 11 lives, the US Geological Survey recorded. Above the village, a rockslide half a kilometer long came down from near the ridge top, about 100 Olympic swimming pools of rock. That year, the survey assessed 74 landslide dams across the quake zone. And the slopes never settled. Researchers who tracked them for 3 and 1/2 years found more landslides on the map than on the day of the quake, the danger creeping uphill and northward year after year. Which brings us to October 11th. >> [music] >> A landslide dam is a dam built by accident. Rock and earth fall into a gorge and seal it. Water backs up into a lake. There is no spillway and no engineered core. So, when the water finally tops the debris, it cuts down through it fast, and the lake can drain in hours. The US Geological Survey notes that many of these dams are only two or three times the river's depth, so they overtop within days. Historically, more than half fail within a month. Nepal has lived through this again and again. In 2012, people living along the Upper Seti, above Nepal's second city, noticed their roaring river had slowed to a trickle. Then, on May 5th, an avalanche of ice and rock off an Annapurna peak broke the natural dam holding the water back, and the flood that followed claimed 72 lives. In August 2014, a landslide east of Kathmandu dropped 5 and 1/2 million cubic meters of hillside into the Sunkoshi, 2,200 Olympic pools, and built a dam 55 m tall, an 18-story building. 156 lives were lost in the slide itself. When the lake behind it was breached in early September, downstream villages have been widely evacuated and no lives were reported lost. Then there is the version where no single dam is to blame. In June 2021, after 800 mm of rain in 3 weeks, the river that supplies Kathmandu's drinking water let go from its whole upper catchment at once, a catchment holding more than 1,500 landslides left by the 2015 quake. The valley floor was widened three to five times over and buried under 5 to 20 m of sediment. 25 lives were lost. Now look back at October 11th. A slide on a tributary, a cork, a lake, a release, possibly more than one. That is what the authorities suspect. The investigation is still open. >> There is a second way to build a flood without rain. A glacial lake. As a glacier retreats, it leaves a lake behind, a wall of loose rubble, a moraine, with nothing cementing it. A regional inventory published in 2020 counted more than 3 and 1/2 thousand glacial lakes across the big river basins of Nepal, Tibet, and India and ranked 47 of them as potentially dangerous, 21 in Nepal. Since 1977, Nepal has recorded 26 of these outburst floods. What that looks like in real time. In August 2024, in a valley below Everest, an upper lake that had grown to about 11 hectares spilled into a lower one and the lower lake's moraine wall failed. About 770,000 cubic meters of water, 300 Olympic pools, reached the village in 22 minutes with a peak flow above 800 cubic meters a second. The damage was traced 50 km downstream. The exact trigger is still debated. And in April 2024, on this river, a block of the Manaslu glacier broke off into the lake below and the wave reached Autagad by late afternoon. A small flood. A warning. The last reason is one that people built. In the past two decades, Nepal has pushed roads into the hills at speed. In one district east of Kathmandu, road density more than tripled between 1998 and 2016. Many are cut by excavators straight into the slope. Poor drainage, nothing holding the slope, the spoil tipped downhill. A study published in 2018 mapped landslides on that district's farmed hillsides. 45% of the rain-triggered slides from before the earthquake lay within 100 m of a road, the length of a football pitch, against 21% of the earthquake's own slides. "Near a road," the authors wrote, "rain-triggered landslides are more than twice as likely." Add the hydropower sites, like the ones damaged on October 11th, built in the gorges because that is where the falling water is. Add the villages on the river terraces because that is where the flat land is. Nepal does not keep getting hit only because the mountains are harsh. More of Nepal now stands where the floods go. Two claims are going around. One, a glacier burst caused this flood. No agency has confirmed that. The satellite evidence points to a landslide on a tributary, and the investigation is open. Two, it is all climate change. The honest answer is narrower. Across 98 stations from 1971 to 2010, extreme rainfall in Nepal did not increase significantly nationwide. It did robustly in the far west. What is certain? The glaciers are retreating, the lakes are growing, and more people, roads, and power plants stand in the path. What to watch. First, the geology team's report. Where the slide is, and whether anything is still blocked up the valley. The disaster authority asked people to stay on safe ground through the night of October 11th. Second, the search for the people still missing by the sheep sheds. Third, the temporary bridge at Adukhola with bridge parts being sent up from the south. And one thing to remember from the people above the Seti in 2012, and from the villagers here on October 11th, when a mountain river suddenly slows or stops, do not go down to look. Go up. This is Stormora.

k4VnDLzI5EQ.title: Jakarta Landslide Horror: Road Crumbles, Homes Flood As Residents Fear Another Collapse
k4VnDLzI5EQ.description:
A second landslide in less than two weeks has struck South Jakarta after heavy rainfall, collapsing a section of road, blocking a drainage channel and flooding nearby homes.

The latest landslide hit Jalan Langgar II in Pejaten Timur, Pasar Minggu, where soil and debris slid into the PHB Poltangan drainage channel. The blockage caused water to overflow into surrounding homes, with floodwater reaching up to 50 centimetres in some areas.

Footage shows the damaged road, collapsed retaining wall, debris blocking the waterway and residents clearing mud, damaged furniture and belongings from flooded homes. The incident reportedly affected 217 people from 65 families, with five residents injured.

Residents fear another collapse as the ground remains unstable and heavy rainfall threatens to worsen the situation. The same location was hit by a landslide on November 10, damaging the road and partially obstructing the drainage channel.

Authorities and response teams have been deployed to clear debris and carry out emergency measures, including temporary barriers and protective coverings along the damaged slope, while calls grow for a permanent retaining wall to prevent further collapses.

8fI6Z64fcHM.title: 岐阜・高山市の国道で土砂崩れ　走行中の車乗り上げ …男性搬送(2026年2月25日)
8fI6Z64fcHM.description:
25日朝早く、岐阜県高山市の国道で土砂崩れが発生し、車が土砂に乗り上げ、運転していた男性が病院に搬送されました。

　消防によりますと、午前5時半ごろ、高山市丹生川町塩屋の国道158号で「土砂崩れが起きている」と通行人から通報がありました。

　消防が駆け付けたところ、土砂崩れの現場で車が土砂に乗り上げていたということです。

　運転していた40代の男性は胸や顔などを打って病院に搬送されましたが、命に別状はないとみられます。

　県の高山土木事務所によりますと、現場は土砂で覆われ通行できなくなっています。

　職員らが状況を確認していますが、復旧のめどは立っていません。

IiXYKT3KgCY.title: 【瞬間】熱海市の住民が撮影した土石流の動画 【landslide】
IiXYKT3KgCY.description:
静岡県 #熱海市 であった大規模な #土石流 から１カ月が経った。あの日、何が起きたのか。住民らが撮影した動画で被害の実相をたどる。

#landslide #japan  #disaster 

Landslide hit high-risk area of Atami built on volcanic ash
https://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/14387233

ATAMI, Shizuoka Prefecture--The disaster that befell this seaside resort town was an accident waiting to happen, say experts citing the steep mountainside on which it is built and poor soil quality due to huge ancient deposits of volcanic ash.

Heavy rains that battered the area since July 1 exacerbated an already precarious situation, resulting in a massive mudslide July 3 that sent torrents of mud, water and debris crashing into homes and buildings in the Izusan district, claiming the lives of two people initially and leaving around 20 others missing.

Hiroshi Takebayashi, an associate professor of erosion control engineering at Kyoto University’s Disaster Prevention Research Institute, said videos of the landslide posted on social media showed a flow of dark debris containing volcanic ash.

“The videos indicate that the mud and water flowed at a rate of 30 kph,” he said. “Under normal circumstances, mud flows are not that destructive. But on this occasion, the mudslide was between 4 and 5 meters high when it came, reaching the second floors of homes.”

The mountainside upon which Atami is built is susceptible to collapse, especially during torrential downpours and typhoons, as it is made up of vast deposits of volcanic ash and rocks that melted in an ancient volcanic eruption.

The seaside town in Shizuoka Prefecture, famed for its hot springs, is surrounded by group of volcanoes, including Mount Hakone, according to Susumu Yasuda, professor emeritus of geotechnical engineering at Tokyo Denki University.

A hazard map issued by the land ministry shows that Izusan and nearby communities are designated as areas in danger from collapse and landslides.

When the magnitude 7.9 Great Kanto Earthquake devastated Tokyo and surrounding areas in 1923, a large-scale mudslide occurred near the district, according to Yasuda.

The vulnerability of the rock and soil in Atami, coupled with heavy downpours since July 1, compounded the situation, experts said.

Total rainfall through 10:30 a.m. on July 3 came to a whopping 465 millimeters, according to a rain gauge set up in the Minaguchi district of Atami, which is located in the vicinity of Izusan.

As a result, the Izusan district and nearby areas faced a greater risk of landslides, given the recent heavy rainfall and vulnerability of the surface soil.

الى حتى هذه اللحظه لازال التوتر الامني هو المسيطر والعنوان الرئيس على الاقل في شوارع المدينه ضحى >> هل هناك هل التحركات العسكريه ما زالت مستمره ونتحدث عن تحركات عسكريه حجم هذه التحركات العسكريه ومن اي المناطق الى اي المناطق فرج >> التحركات العسكريه بشكل متقطع على مدار اليوم هنا نتحدث ضحى سواء كان في مناطق غرب العاصمه والمصادر تتحدث بشكل مكثف عن القوات القادمه من مدينه الزاويه بدات في الدخول شيئا فشيئا الى مدن او بعض المناطق داخل العاصمه طرابلس هناك القوات التابعه لما يعرف بالامن العام ايضا بدات تتحرك من داخل المناطق العاصمه من منطقه الى اخرى قوات فض النزاع وهنا الكتائب او المجموعات المطالبه بفض النزاع من خلال مجموعات الترتيبات الامنيه التي فرضتها المجلس الرئاسي تحدثت هي الاخرى ان لديها بعض القوات قادمه من مدينه مصراته لمحاوله فض النزاع او محاوله اعاده تمركزها في العاصمه طرابلس بعد ان كانت انسحبت في اوقات سابقه تحسبا لاي طارئ كما تقول ايه هذه او هذه اللجان بالمناسبه ضحى الحديث عن اسباب عوده هذا النزاع من جديد وهنا نتحدث عن التصريحات او حرب الحرب الكلاميه ما بين الطرفين سواء من قبل رئيس حكومه الوحده الوطنيه او حتى من بعض ايه ال المحتجين الذين كانوا يتحدثون عن بيانات مناهضه للحكومه المتواجده في طرابلس رئيس الحكومه بشكل مستمر يحاول التاكيد على ضروره اخراج جميع القوات من من العاصمه طرابلس وهنا يشير دائما بشكل غير مباشر حتى الى قوات الردع المتمركزه في قاعده المعتيقه او المتمركزه في مطار معتيجه هناك ضحى >> سنبقى في متابعه معك اذا مراسل الحدث فرج حمزه كنت معنا بن غازي شكرا جزيلا يجتمع رؤساء كل من الصين وروسيا وكوريا الشماليه للمره الاولى فيما يراقب الرئيس الامريكي وقاده الغرب التحركات في اسيا بحسب ما نقلت رويترز عن محللين راوا ان هذا الاجتماع دليل على عزم الصين باعاده تعريف النظام العالمي الذي يقوده الغرب لا سما مع التوتر بالتحالفات الامريكيه القائمه بسبب سياسه تراب الذي انتقده الرئيس الصيني في تلميح لترامب دون ان يسميه فيما اسماه بالهيمره السياسيه والتنمر وبموازاه ذلك عرض الرئيس الصيني ونظيره الروسي رؤيتهما لنظام امني واقتصادي عالمي جديد على اكثر من 20 من قاده الدول غير الغربيه الاجتماع التاريخي للزعماء الثلاثه في الصين غدا يثير احتمال ظهور محور ثلاثي جديد يقوم على اتفاقيه الدفاع المشترك ينضم الينا من موسكو اندريه انتكوف المحلل السياسي اهلا بك معنا على شاشه الحدث ما المنتظر من اجتماع الغد >> نعم هو الاجتماع المهم جدا ويعكس التقارب مستمر بين دول الثلاثه وبتبيعه الحل هذا التقارب مرتبط ب بطبيعه الحل التحديات صادره من قبل من الولايات المتحده الامريكيه ومن العالم الغربي يعني التحديات التي تستطدم بها كل من من كل طرف يعني روسيا في اوكرانيا الصين في يعني في بحر الكوريا الشماليه كذلك تستخدم بالتحديات صادره من الدول الغربيه فلذلك يعني على ما يبدو الخيار الوحيد المتبقي بالنسبه لدول الثلاث هو مزيد من التقارب كما ذكرت في السابق تطوير المشاريع المشتركه وتشكيل نوع من المجموعه لاجل يعني مواجهه هذه التحديات الصادره من الدوله الخربيه كما ذكرت في السابق على كل حال يعني من الواضح تماما ان مع مرور الزمن اعلم احديه القطب قد انتهى وهناك حاجه هناك النمو الاقتصادي لصين هناك النمو الاقتصادي والعسكري لروسيا النمو الاقتصادي لدول الاخرى فبطبيب الحال >> لا مجال ل لقواعد اللعب القديمه التي كانت ما بعد انهيار الاتحاد السوفيتي السابق هذه هذه الدول الصين روسيا كوريا الشماليه يجتمعون للمره الاولى هذا الاجتماع بحد ذاته ما هي الرساله من ورائه >> كما ذكرت هي رساله بان تتشكل رويد رويد النوع من المجموعه الجديده من المبكر ربما نتحدث عن التحالف بسبب ان على كل حال يعني يوجد لدى الصين تعاون التجاري والاقتصادي مع الولايات المتحده الامريكيه نفس شيء توجد هناك العلاقات السياسيه او على الاقل محاولات لاده البناء العلاقات السياسيه مع واشنطن ولكن في نفس الوقت كما ايضا ذكرت في السابق الاتحاديات التي تستخدم بها الدول الثلاث تدفع تلك الدول مزيد من التقارب وخاصه ان تلك التحديات اصبحت ليس فقط التحديات الاقتصاديه بل كذلك العسكريه وليس سرا ان كان هناك ولا يزال هناك تعاون ما بين روسيا وصين خاصه في دول استمرار العمليه العسكريه في اوكرانيا كذلك جنود من كوريا الشماليه قد شاركوا في مواجهه القوات الاوكرانيه والمرتزقه الاجانب يعني جانب الاجانب مع القوات الروسيه فلذلك اعتقد هذا الاجتماع يعكس مستوى التعاون بين الدول الثلاث >> اين يترك ذلك الولايات المتحده الامريكيه والدول الاوروبيه >> هذا السؤال ممتاز جدا انا ذكرت سابقا بان هذا هذا التقار رب لا يمنع استمرار التعاون الاقتصادي والتجاري مع الولايات المتحده الامريكيه او الدوله الاوروبيه ولكن يعني نحن بحاجه الى تغيير قواعد اللعبه عندما بعد الانهيار الاتحاد السوفيتي كان هناك محاولات وليس فقط المحاولات بل بشكل عام تجاهل لمصالح الدوله الاخرى من قبل امريكا وحلفاء الولايات المتحده الامريكيه ولكن انا اعتقد ان حان الوقت لتغيير هذه قواعد اللعبه وتجد هناك مصالح توجد هناك مخاوف لدى كل من روسيا وصين وكوريا الشماليه وغيره من الدول فيجب ان يكون هناك احترام لكل تلك المصالح والمخاوف ولذلك نحن بحاجه الى بناء العلاقات على اساس المساواه المساواه السياسيه والاقتصاديه والعسكريه حتى يعني لكي لا يكون هناك تعزيز الامن لدوله او تحالف على حساب دوله qtv56rzVMY8.title: Үш облыста сел мен жер көшкіні қаупі жарияланды
qtv56rzVMY8.description:
Арнаға тіркел / Подпишись на канал: https://www.youtube.com/@UCqzhjBGNNwAIOH4u0YlJ6NA 

Еліміздің бірден үш облысында сел мен жер көшкіні қаупі жарияланды. «Қазселденқорғау» мекемесінің мәліметінше, аптап ыстық пен алдағы күндері күтілетін жаңбырға байланысты 3-5 шілде аралығында Алматы, Жамбыл және Жетісу облысының таулы аймағындағы өзендердегі су деңгейі көтерілуі мүмкін. Алматы қаласында құтқарушылар күшейтілген жұмыс тәртібіне көшті. Олар таудағы өзендердің жағдайын тұрақты бақылап, су басу қаупі туындаған жағдайда жедел әрекет етуге дайын. Әзірге ешқандай төтенше жағдай тіркелген жоқ. Мамандар тұрғындар мен туристерге сақ болуға, әсіресе ауа райы қолайсыз кезде тауға шықпауға кеңес береді.
ГҮЛДАНА НҰРЫМБЕТОВА, АЛМАТЫ ҚАЛАСЫ ТЖД РЕСМИ ӨКІЛІ:
- Өзен арналары мен сел қаупі бар учаскелерге тәулік бойы мониторинг жүргізілуде. Бөлімшелер Үлкен Алматы, Кіші Алматы және Қарғалы өзендеріндегі мониторинг бекеттерінен жағдай туралы сағат сайын ақпарат беруде. Сонымен қатар су ағынының кедергісіз өтуін қамтамасыз ету мақсатында Ақсай өзенінің арнасы тазартылды.

VdKZ9ziRZ1I.title: Maporomoko Ya Ardhi Pokot
VdKZ9ziRZ1I.description: Watu wawili wameripotiwa kufariki baada ya kupigwa na radi huku  wengine zaidi ya  mia saba wakilazimika kukosa makao  kufuatia maporomoko ya ardhi  katika eneo bunge la Pokot kusini. Wakaazi wa eeneo hilo sasa wanaitaka serikali kutuma wataalam kuchunguza kiini cha maporomoko ambayo yamekuwa yakishuhudiwa mara kwa mara katika kaunti ya Pokot magharibi.
VdKZ9ziRZ1I.transcript: Taswira katika kitongoji cha Chebaren eneo bunge la Pokot Kusini. Makali ya mvua kubwa inayoendelea kunyesha katika kaunti ya Poot Magharibi sasa ni wazi kwa wenyeji hapa. Watu wawili wameripotiwa kufariki na mmoja kujariuhiwa baada ya kupigwa na radi. Watu wengi ambao hawana sasa makao ni karibu nyumba au households 140. Hiyo ni karibu watu 700. Mazao katika shamba hili hayakusazwa huku wakulima wakigharamia hasara kutokana na maporomoko haya. Wengi wamebaki kuwa wakimbizi kwao nyumbani. Wanahitaji msaada kama mahali pa kukaa ya mapati, mablangeti na hata vyakula. Watoto wengi wameumia kwa sababu ya neonia. Kwao hiki sio kisa cha kwanza. It is not even one month ago. Watoto walikuwa kwa nyumba light ikashika in the same linea juzi saramea juzi inashika mtu the same line na hakuna department relevant ya serikali imekuja pande hii. Mbunge wa pokot kusini David Kosing alizuru eneo la mkasa na kutoa wito kwa serikali kutuma wataalam wa jeolojia kuanzisha uchunguzi kubaini kiini cha maporomoko hayo. Kosing amekariri kushangazwa na utepetevu wa idara inayohusika na majanga nchini licha ya idara hiyo kutengewa pesa kwenye bajeti ya kitaifa. Naomba wananchi ya pande hii waende kwa sever ground kwa wakati huu sasa kwa sababu sasa hata hakuna department ya serikali imekuja pande hii. Wenyeji hapa wakistajabishwa na kisa hiki takwimu zaonyesha kuwa katika kaunti ya Pocot Magharibi kwa miezi miwili sasa zaidi ya watu 10 wamepoteza maisha na wengi kusalia bila makao kufuatia misururi ya maporomoko na radi. Ben Chumba, Citizen Nipashe. M.

wgsr18dQcME.title: SERIKALI YAIPONGEZA WIZARA YA ARDHI KWA UPIMAJI VIWANJA 268 KWA WAATHIRIKA WA MAAFA HANANG
wgsr18dQcME.description:
SUBSCEIBE CHANNEL YETU SHARE LIKE COMMENT....Waziri Mkuu wa Jamuhuri ya Muungano wa Tanzania Mhe. Kassim Majaliwa (Mb.) ameipongeza Wizara ya Ardhi Nyumba na Maendeleo ya Makazi kwa kuhakikisha upimaji wa eneo la kitongoji cha Waret kwa kuzingatia kanuni za mipango miji kwa ajili ya uanzishaji wa makazi kwa waathirika wa maporomoko ya tope.

Mhe. Waziri Mkuu amesema hayo leo Tarehe 20 Desemba 2024 katika uzinduzi wa Nyumba 109 za waathirika wa maporomoko ya tope  yaliyotokea December 03, 2023 zilizojengwa katika kitongoji cha Waret, kijiji cha Gidagamowd, Wilaya ya Hanang mkoani Manyara. 

Ujenzi wa nyumba hizo ulitokana na maamuzi ya Rais Dkt. Samia baada ya kutembelea eneo hilo ambapo Serikali imesema uamuzi huo ni muendelezo wa dhamira ya dhati ya Serikali ya kuwalinda Wananchi wake na kurejesha hali ili waendelee na mfumo wa maisha baada ya maafa.

Katika hatua nyingine Waziri Mkuu amewaagiza viongozi wa Halmashauri ya Wilaya ya Hanang waratibu zoezi la ugawaji wa viwanja vya ziada vilivyopo katika eneo hilo ili kuendeleza eneo hilo. 

Wizara ya Ardhi ilipewa jukumu la kupima, kupanga na kumilikisha eneo la ekari 100 ambapo jumla ya viwanja 268 vilipatikana ikiwa 234 ni makazi pekee, 17 Makazi na biashara, 7 Biashara pekee na 10 huduma za Jamii.

Sasa pale mwamba unapokatika hilo tukio linasababisha ardhi kutikisika. Sasa ardhi inapotikisifika ndicho sisi ambacho tunakiita ni tetemeko la ardhi. Na mara nyingi hiyo hutokea katika kina kirefu sana cha ardhi chini ya ardhi. Lakini pia inaweza ikatokea katika kina kifupi. Na pale inapotokea huo mpasuko unapotokea katika kina kifupi unasababisha madhara makubwa kwa vitu ambavyo viko kwenye uso wa ardhi ikiwa ni pamoja na nyumba, majengo, barabara. na miundobinu ambayo husababisha pia hata maafa kwa binadamu. Ah kwa Tanzania hapajawahi kutokea madhara makubwa kama hayo lakini kwa ukubwa wa matetemeko yapo ambayo yamewahi kutokea ambayo ni makubwa zaidi ya hilo la Italia la 6.2 mbili ye kwa sababu tulishawahi kuwa na matetemeko ya 5.9 wakati ule mlima waonyo Lengai unafukuta kulipuka alafu pia tuliwahi kuwa na tetemeko la 7.4 maeneo ya ziwa Tanganyika lakini hapakuweza kuwa na madhara makubwa kama yaliyotokea Italia. madhara yanategemea kwa sababu tetemeko linaweza ikawa ni dogo hata la 4.0 au 5.1 lakini madhara yakawa makubwa kuliko tetemeko la 7.2 mbili inategemea hilo tetemeko limetokea maeneo gani kwa sababu linapotokea tetemeko yale mawimbi ya tetemeko huwa yana yanasafiri kwa kasi sana katika miamba mumu na yanasafiri kwa kasi ndogo katika maeneo yenye miamba ambayo ah sio migumu. Kwa hiyo madhara makubwa yanatokea katika maeneo ambayo yana miamba ambayo sio migumu. Kwa sababu kwenye mwamba ambao sio mgumu kasi ya mawimbi ya tetemeko inakuwa ni ndogo. Kwa hiyo muda ambao yale mawimbi yanachukua kupita katika lile eneo unakuwa ni muda mrefu. Kwa hiyo eneo lile linakuwa linatikiswa na yale mawimbi kwa muda mrefu sana. Kwa mfano hili tetemeko la Italia limechukua sekunde 20. Sasa na sekunde 20 bado unaweza ukaziona ni nyingi. That's why kumekuwa na madhara makubwa. Mh. Lakini pia unaweza kuta sasa tetemeko likawa na ni kubwa sana kama 7.4 lakini usisikie madhara kwa sababu labda mawimbi katika maeneo ambayo yamepita ile miamba ni migumu. Alafu m alfu sio kwamba tu madhara yanatokea pale mahali ambapo tetemeko limetokea. Kuna wakati tetemeko linaweza likatokea kwa mfano 2010 lilitokea tetemeko mjini Kigoma katika mji wa Kigoma. kitfu chake kilikuwa katikati ya mji wa Kigoma lakini watu wa mji wa Kigoma hawakujua kwamba lilitokea tetemeko la ardhi madhara yake yalisikika katika miji ya Dar es Salaam na Arusha kwa hiyo inategemea ya na nature ya mawimbi na aina ya miamba ambayo yale mawimbi yanatafsiri na mpaka sasa hivi teknolojia haijaweza kugundua namna ya kubashiri kwamba tetemeko linaweza likatokea kwa kiasi kidogo sana unaweza ukabashiri kwamba tetemeko linaweza likatokea lakini kwa era ya plato minus 10 to 20 years. Sasa information kama hiyo inaweza isimsaidie sana mtu kumwambia baada ya miaka 30 lakini plus or minus 10 to 15 years tetemeko lichotokea inakuwa sio sio accurate. Na hakuna namna ambayo unaweza ukayazuia matetemeko kwa sababu haya ni majanga ya asili ni matukio ya asili kutokana na nguvu za siri hakuna namna ambayo unaweza ukaya ni lazima yatokee. Labda ambacho unaweza kufanya ni kuchukua tahadhari ya kuweza kupunguza madhara ambayo yanaweza yakatokea wakati tetemeko la ardhi linatokea. Maanake la ardhi linapotokea kile kishindo cha kwanza linapotokea kwa mara ya kwanza huwa linafuatiwa na matetemeko mengine madogo madogo ambayo yanaweza yakadumu kwa kipindi cha masaa, wiki au miezi baada ya lile tukio la kwanza kubwa la kwanza. Kwa hiyo muda wote watu wanatakiwa wawe katika hali ya dhari. [Muziki]

Séismes, inondations, feux de forêt, avalanches, cyclones... Les risques naturels sont nombreux, de toutes sortes, et s'intensifient avec le changement climatique. Avec Fred et la Petite Voix, passons en revue les principaux risques et les moyens de s'y préparer.

vxuiF8lnmiE.transcript: [musique] [musique] Bonjour à toutes et à tous. Dans ce nouvel épisode sur la prévention des risques majeurs, je vais vous parler des mouvements de terrain. Vous me direz, c'est vaste. En effet, il existe plusieurs types de mouvements de terrain. Les éboulements, les effondrements de cavité souterraine, les glissements de terrain, les coulé de bout, le retrait gonflement des sols argileux et les causes sont également très diverses. Ce qui rend l'analyse de ce phénomène particulièrement complexe. Une chose les distingue nettement, c'est leur vitesse. Il y a des mouvements de terrain lents et d'autres très rapides. Mais dans tous les cas, si l'on est informé du phénomène, on peut l'anticiper et donc s'en protéger. Les mouvements de terrain comme disait Newton, c'est une histoire de gravité à tous les sens du terme. [musique] Dans la famille des mouvements de terrain, il y a donc ceux qui sont lents et ceux qui sont rapides. La première catégorie, les mouvements lents, est particulièrement insidieuse car on ne la voit pas forcément venir. On ne l'imagine même pas. Le terrain glisse lentement de quelques millimètres par an seulement et un jour, sous l'effet par exemple de forte pluie, il finit par se disloquer. C'est ce que l'on appelle un glissement de terrain. Ces maisons de la Martinique, par exemple, étaient construites sur un sol déjà gorgé d'eau. Il a suffi d'un épisode de pluie intense pour que tout un quartier soit emporté en l'espace d'une nuit, heureusement sans faire de victime. Tous ces mouvements de terrain sont généralement déclenchés par des phénomènes naturels climatiques tels que la fonte des neiges, des plus intense, un séisme, mais ils peuvent également être d'origine entropique, autrement dit provoqué par l'homme, par exemple à la suite de travaux de terrassement, de déboisement ou encore l'exploitation de nau souterraine. Enfin, parmi les mouvements de terrain lent, il y a aussi le phénomène naturel de retrait gonflement des argiles qui lesard de les façades des maison construite sur certains sols argileux. Sur ce thème, je vous invite à regarder l'épisode spécial que nous y avons consacré. Et puis il y a la famille des mouvements de terrain rapides et brutaux. Et là, généralement, ça ne prévient pas. C'est le cas des éboulements et des chutes de blocs de pierre comme on peut le voir ici filmé au ralenti. Mieux vaut ne pas être sur leur trajectoire. C'est souvent l'alternance de période de gel et de dégelisses dans la roche, mais aussi encore une fois de fortes pluies qui peuvent déclencher ces éboulements. Tout comme d'ailleurs les coulés de bou qui peuvent dévaler les pentes à grande vitesse lorsque des pluies d'illu viennent s'abattent sur des sols très secs en chariant tout sur leur passage, des arbres mais aussi des blocs de roche. Enfin, dans la famille des mouvements de terrain brutaux, il y a les effondrements. En géologie, on appelle cela des fonties. Ils sont causés par la présence de cavités souterraines qui peuvent être d'origine naturelle, notamment dans les sols comme le calcaire ou le gymps ou encore d'origine entropique, par exemple, d'anciennes carrières ou mines abandonnées. Alors, et vous, êtes-vous concerné par un ou plusieurs risques de mouvement de terrain ? C'est parti pour un petit tour de France. Il suffirait d'un éboulement en pied de falaise pour qu'au sommet le terrain s'effondre en portant avec lui les maisons. Loin du littoral et des montagnes, nous ne sommes pas à l'abri non plus des mouvements de terrain. Le risque ici est même beaucoup plus sournois [musique] car on ne le voit pas. À ce jour, 500000 cavités souterraines ont été recensées en France. [musique] Parfois elles sont d'origine naturelle, parfois elles ont été creusées par l'homme. En tout cas, 7000 communes sont aujourd'hui concernées par le risque d'effondrement de ces cavités. Donc, un petit conseil, avant d'acheter ou de construire une maison, renseignez-vous sur ce qu'il y a sous vos pieds. Alors, comment s'informer pour éviter la catastrophe ? Et bien, on voit ça tout de suite. [musique] Depuis 1994, le bureau de recherche géologique et minière, le BRGM, tient un inventaire de tous les événements qui ont provoqué un mouvement de terrain en France, ainsi que toutes les cavités souterraines connues. Cette cartographie à l'échelle départementale permet d'identifier tous les type de mouvement de terrain susceptible de toucher votre territoire. C'est le document d'information communale sur les risques majeurs que votre mairie doit pouvoir vous fournir sur papier ou sur son site internet. C'est obligatoire et ce document vous informe également sur tous les risques qui menacent votre future habitation. Voilà. Et une fois bien informé, vous pouvez anticiper le risque. Ces plans ont pour but évidemment de prévenir, mais surtout ils fixent des réglementations, par exemple en limitant ou en interdisant toute construction sur certaines parcelles. Et puis ils peuvent aussi interdire certains aménagements pouvant aggraver ou engendrer de nouveaux risques. Enfin, ils permettent de définir des mesures de prévention, de protection et de sauvegarde adapté à chaque territoire et à chaque aléa. Menurut pihak berkuasa wilayah Nagano, usaha untuk menilai keadaan laluan serta memastikan keselamatan individu yang terkandas sedang dijalankan. M.

Mangsa seorang doktor dikenali sebagai Wong Carlin tertimbus di bahagian dapur rumahnya manakala dua lagi ahli keluarganya ditemui selamat. Penolong Pengarah Bahagian Operasi Kebombaan dan Penyelamat Jabatan Bomba dan Penyelamat Malaysia atau JBPM Pulau Pinang, John Sagun Francis berkata pihaknya menerima panggilan kecemasan pada jam 8:36 pagi. Anggota penyelamat bertungkus lumus mengeluarkan mangsa yang terperangkap menggunakan peralatan khas sebelum mayatnya berjaya dikeluarkan pada jam 1120 pagi. Mangsa disahkan meninggal dunia di lokasi kejadian oleh petugas perubatan Kementerian Kesihatan akibat kecederaan trauma parah. Menurut John, aliran air akibat hujan lebat berterusan sejak semalam dipercayai menjejaskan kestabilan cering menyebabkan tanah menjadi tidak stabil sebelum runtuh. Pemeriksaan dari udara penting untuk mengenal pasti rekahan baharu. atau pergerakan tanah yang tidak dapat dilihat dari bawah sekaligus membantu menentukan tahap risiko dan keperluan kerja mitigasi. Beberapa anggota teknikal turut dilihat menjalankan penilaian struktur di kawasan laluan runtuhan bagi memastikan punca dengan tindakan susulan bagi keselamatan penduduk yang menetap di kawasan itu. Difahamkan Dewan Bandaraya Kuala Lumpur DBKL akan mengadakan mesyuarat penyelarasan berkaitan tanah runtuh dan akan memaklumkan semula mengenai tempoh pembersihan dan pemasangan benteng sementara. Sementara itu, kerja pembersihan di lokasi dilaporkan sudah pun bermula sejak malam kejadian. Ia termasuk pemotongan pokok serta pembersihan batu serta tanah runtuh di bahagian bawah cerun.

LjhG0gCdjT4.transcript: The story starts with a classroom exam in Konoha's Ninja Academy, the school the Second Hokage builds to supply the village with talent. Hiruzen Sarutobi, Danzo Shimura, and even the three Sannin all come out of this place. A Chunin teacher calls the next name. Kazan. A sturdy, tiger-headed kid walks up, forms the seals, and pops out one clone in a puff of smoke. The teacher writes down sixty points. A pass, and nothing more. Kazan cancels the clone and returns to his seat with a flat face, because he does not care about the score at all. Kazan is a reincarnator, and he carries a cheat nobody in this class knows about. He knows the exam kills people. He calls it a mission from the Third, hides the coming war, and gives her the clean version. The village needs money after the last war, and a strong showing pulls in clients. Then Kurenai notices his forehead protector. It is not new, but it is not worn out either, and it feels secondhand. Kazan pulls it off and tosses it to her. It is Hiruzen's own protector. Everyone who sees it gets the message. Kazan is under the Hokage's protection now. On the walk back, Shinku waits at his own door and drops the real arrangement. For the days before the exam, he personally trains Kazan on genjutsu. Not casting it. Surviving it. A fist-only fighter like Kazan has exactly one natural predator, and it is genjutsu, so Hiruzen sends him to Konoha's specialist to learn how it works and how to break it. Shinku even offers him a room. Kazan accepts on the spot, and completely misses Kurenai giving her father a thumbs-up behind his back. Shinku lays down one condition for his daughter. She still attends the Academy on time, and she does not disturb Kazan's training. Dinner proves her right and still catches the whole family off guard. Two rounds of fusion with the Garp Template push Kazan's body into absurd territory, and his training burns fuel like a furnace. The table empties at terrifying speed. Kazan tells them to wait, launches himself upward with Shave, and smashes straight through their roof. Shave moves in a dead straight line, and Kazan still cannot steer it. The Yuhi family stares at the hole until Kazan pokes his head back through it and promises, very sincerely, that he repairs the damage himself later. He keeps his word about feeding himself, too. A crash shakes the backyard, and a huge beast's corpse lands there, already cleaned and ready to grill. Then his pupils shrink, because a massive tiger is staring at his family over the garden wall. That is Hakimi. Hakimi lifts a paw to climb in, Shinku throws himself in front of his precious bonsai, and Hakimi roars and raises the paw to swat the two-legged creature blocking his path. One cold look from Kazan freezes that paw in midair. Hakimi whines like a scolded house cat and sits back down. Kazan apologizes, hops onto the tiger's back, and settles him outside the village, but Hakimi bolts down the street at full speed to get there. The ride terrifies half the neighborhood, flattens market stalls, knocks one unlucky kid flat as a speed bump, a kid named Obito Uchiha, and brings the Uchiha Police Force straight to the Hokage's office with a formal complaint. Hiruzen barely dismisses the Uchiha before Kazan announces himself by punching through the office's brand-new window. He orders Kazan to repair every house the tiger run damages, right now, and Kazan agrees instantly. Then, on his way out, Kazan looks at the other window, the intact one, feels his hand itch, and punches that one out too. A room needs ventilation, old man. Hiruzen nearly loses his liver to rage as Kazan vanishes into the night on Moon Walk. Kazan outsources the repairs to his own Shadow Clones. Then he returns to the Yuhi house, where Kurenai feeds him every dried persimmon snack in the house. Then the lesson starts, and Shinku gets serious. Genjutsu attacks the mind by hijacking the chakra flow in the target's nerves and scrambling the five senses. It travels through sight, sound, and touch. Sight is the Uchiha's game. One look into a Sharingan and the victim is already inside. Rumor says Madara Uchiha needs a single glance to bury someone in a deep illusion. Sound is worse. Mount Myoboku holds a sound-based genjutsu that seeps in with no gaps at all. Kurenai asks how anyone defends against that. Shinku gives two answers. Seal your own hearing completely, which no normal ninja can do, or kill the caster before the song finishes, because sound genjutsu needs time to sink in. For ordinary genjutsu, disrupting your own chakra flow breaks the hold. As for touch-based genjutsu, Shinku admits he only hears rumors. Kazan actually knows more here than his teacher. The Uchiha's ultimate illusion, Izanami, works through physical contact, recording the opponent's actions until it traps them in an endless loop. Theory ends fast. Shinku warns Kazan to get ready and casts before the warning even finishes. Falling Sakura. Kazan's head goes heavy and dark in an instant, and through the fog he hears Shinku's voice telling him to disrupt his chakra. Kazan detonates his. His chakra erupts like a volcano, blows the genjutsu apart from the inside, shakes the whole yard, and launches Kurenai clean off her feet. Shinku flashes in and catches her. Under Kazan's feet, the stone path cracks apart. Shinku stares at the sheer volume of chakra this Genin just throws around, and then his shock turns into genuine anger. Bursting chakra like that shreds an ordinary body from the inside. Kazan has to promise never to do it again. Kazan tries to explain. Ordinary ninja break. He is not ordinary. He trains a technique that hardens every part of him, organs included, until his insides are as tough as his fists. Shinku does not believe a word, so Kazan invites him to test it. Punch him. Shinku punches a child at his own request, and his fist rings off Kazan's chest with the clang of striking steel. He hides it behind his back so fast that even Kazan almost misses it. The technique is called Iron Body, one of the Six Powers, and Shinku asks the question that matters. Can other people learn it? In theory, yes, Kazan says. Then he looks Shinku up and down and delivers the verdict. But your body is too weak. Bro really tells a Jonin, to his face, that his body does not qualify. Shinku laughs out loud. Him, weak? He may specialize in illusions, but he trains taijutsu his whole career as insurance against close combat, and he ranks his hand-to-hand skill in the top ten of his generation. Kurenai tugs his sleeve and tries to save him. Kazan is not lying. His current punching bag is the mountain behind the Hokage's office. Shinku hears none of it. He demands a test. Full power. Hit him with everything. Kazan hesitates. Shinku insists. The punch lands and Shinku disappears through the wall of his own house. Kurenai and her mother scream and rush in to check if he still breathes. He does, barely, and he learns the truth at the cost of one wall and most of his dignity. Kazan really can burst his chakra to shred genjutsu, and his body really can take it. Shinku climbs out of the wreckage, bleeding from the corner of his mouth, and bluffs like a champion. A punch like that is nothing. He fights the Third Raikage back in his day and walks away fine. Kazan points at the blood. Shinku changes the subject and doubles the training. From the next day, on a proper training ground, the lessons turn into live combat. Kazan has to break genjutsu while a Jonin actively tries to cut him down. Shinku comes in with a blade. Kazan plants his stance and shouts Iron Body, and the blade rings off him like it hits a steel plate. But Shinku teaches while he attacks. Iron Body locks him in place. A defense that cannot move is a fatal flaw. Then the hand signs finish. Demon Illusion: Tree Binding Death, the very technique Kurenai herself one day uses against Itachi Uchiha. Vines burst from the ground and wrap Kazan whole. His senses scream the warning the instant they sprout, his chakra detonates, and the illusion dies in one second. He spins and punches the charging Shinku out of the air, and the body bursts into smoke. A Shadow Clone, prepared the moment the genjutsu lands. But a flash of insight splits through Kazan's mind, and without thinking, he turns and drives his fist straight into the ground beneath his own feet. The punch cracks the training field open and blasts Shinku out of the earth itself. No Monstrous Strength behind it, just a fist, and it still fishes a Jonin out of the ground like a mole. Shinku recovers midair and fires back instantly. Three Absolute Sakura. Countless petals fill Kazan's vision out of thin air, and his chakra erupts and tears them away before the follow-up even starts. For a genjutsu specialist, a target who bursts illusions instantly, at zero cost, is a natural predator. Kazan is already moving. Shave folds the distance between them into a single step, and his fist grows huge in Shinku's face with no room to dodge. Smoke bursts. A log splits apart where Shinku stands a heartbeat ago. Substitution. Kazan whips around on instinct, and there Shinku is, hands already weaving the next technique, calling out Falling Sakura again. Kazan bursts his chakra on reflex, and walks straight into the trap. This time it is not genjutsu at all. It is a wind technique, and the blast throws Kazan through a boulder. Shinku delivers the lesson calmly. Information decides half of every ninja battle, maybe more. A taijutsu fighter starts at a natural disadvantage there, so he has to think and probe while he fights. Kazan charges out of the dust anyway. The wind blast does not even scratch his Iron Body. Shave closes dozens of meters in a breath and his fist comes down like a landslide. Shinku slips away with the Body Flicker Technique, and one heartbeat later Kazan is somehow in front of him again, fist already arriving. The punch launches Konoha's genjutsu master dozens of meters. Shinku's blocking arms go numb to the shoulder. One inch less chakra in that guard and a Genin breaks a Jonin's bones today. But what truly shakes him is the tracking. Kazan reads his Body Flicker destination the instant he moves. Kazan names it himself. Observation Haki. It is not fully awake yet, but it is close, sharpened by days of eating genjutsu he cannot see coming. At its peak, it stretches the five senses so far that a user glimpses moments into the future. Every technique this child invents is stronger than most ninjutsu, and Shinku sees Kage-level potential in him, asking for another round. Then Kazan tears his shirt off, and the cross-shaped scars across his chest stop Shinku cold. Shinku calls the session there. Not because Kazan is done. Because Shinku is. His chakra runs nearly dry, and one more exchange means hand-to-hand against that fist, and a Jonin losing to a child is a story that never dies, especially if his own daughter hears it. Do not rush, he tells Kazan. Techniques need time to settle. Rest, and reflect. Kazan goes home and trains against his own Shadow Clone instead, hunting for that last thread of Observation Haki. Shinku goes home, pours water down his throat like a man crawling out of a desert, and lies to his wife without blinking. Kazan is stubborn, that is all. Shinku knocks him down dozens of times and holds back carefully the whole session, which is why he is so tired. His wife believes every word. The days that follow only get worse. By the second day Shinku cannot last a single morning before he sends Kazan off to reflect alone. At home he tells his wife he accidentally uses too much force and injures the boy, just a scratch compared to his own war wounds. Kazan, meanwhile, spends his afternoons humming an old song about how tired men are. The next afternoon Shinku hears that exact song coming out of the boy's mouth, and his face goes black. He wants an excuse to skip, any excuse, and then Kazan rips his shirt off and announces he can feel it. Observation Haki sits right there, one push from awakening. Shinku swallows his excuses and trains. That night he sits among his bonsai, hollow-eyed, humming the same tired song himself, until Kurenai catches him. He snaps on the proud father mask instantly. Nothing troubles Konoha's genjutsu master. Kazan's training goes fine. The boy gets knocked down and keeps standing back up, that is all. Kurenai relaxes, then says the quiet part out loud. She worries her father might get hurt by Kazan instead, since Kazan fights Forest of Death beasts every day and her father's body is definitely not tougher than those beasts. Shinku laughs to the heavens. Beasts? Compared to him? He is in perfect shape. He even has energy left over for a concert with her mother. Kurenai asks what concert means, and her father coughs and decides she does not need to know yet. The next morning, Shinku Yuhi walks into the Hokage's office to resign from this job before it kills him. Between the daily beatings and everything else draining him at home, one more day of this training puts him in the ground. And then a voice behind him asks, with total innocence, what he is doing here. Shinku spins around. Kazan stands there. The genjutsu master of Konoha physically steps back. Hiruzen watches a Jonin flinch from a Genin and his eyelids start twitching. Kazan says he lives nearby now, up on the back mountain. Hiruzen starts to explain that Shinku just arrives with a request, and Shinku hears the trap closing. If Kazan learns he comes here to quit, the story follows him forever. So the Jonin roars back to life, plants his feet, and makes the worst decision of his life at full volume. He formally requests permission to fight at his full, unrestricted power. Hiruzen stares at him in silence, quietly wondering when he ever restricts the man. Kazan lights up. So that explains it. He wonders why Shinku feels so weak this whole time. Today, then, no holding back from either of them. Kazan plants his stance, cracks his knuckles, and announces it like a death sentence. He attacks with Monstrous Strength. Shinku Yuhi wants to slap his own mouth off his face. Nobody forces him to show off. He does this to himself. Kazan bumps his fists together and asks Hiruzen to prepare training weights for him. Then he goes back to the training ground with Shinku Yuhi, and half a morning leaves Shinku sweating through his clothes. Every Monstrous Strength punch blasts open a crater. Every stomp cracks the earth like a spiderweb. This is no ninja. This is a human tyrannosaurus, and one clean hit puts a man in the ground or in a wheelchair. Shinku decides on the spot that he is done. He tells Kazan to entertain himself and goes to drink alone in a tavern in broad daylight. Hiruzen watches through his crystal ball and shakes his head at Shinku sitting there like a man who has lost his whole life. Then the picture shifts to the Ninja Academy, where the students train with unusual seriousness. The news is already out. Kazan is taking the Chunin Exams. He graduates later than Kakashi, but he now has a shot at the fastest promotion to Chunin in his generation, a record nobody is likely to break. Plenty of classmates refuse to accept that and double down on training. Kurenai praises Kazan without hesitation. Her father trains him personally now and rates him very highly. More than half a month passes, and the air in Konoha turns heavy. Ninja from allied villages arrive as guests, and none of them feel friendly. The Sand look at everyone like a murder suspect. The Cloud wear their arrogance openly, because the Third Raikage runs a village that worships raw strength. Shinku ends the training a few days early, because his duties as an exam proctor call him away, and relief washes over him like a pardon. Kazan's harvest is huge. He learns how ninja actually fight, he receives real genjutsu guidance, and most importantly, his Observation Haki awakens. Shinku tells him to go show the other villages some color, and invites him to dinner that night, where Kurenai and her mother have been cooking since morning. Kazan accepts. Even if the other villages stuff Jonin-level fighters into their teams, he feels no fear at all. The exams open, and Kazan arrives early. Hiruzen assigns him two teammates, Shibi Aburame and Tsume Inuzuka, both of whom qualify for this exam long ago and both of whom hold back for half a year on Hiruzen's orders, just to cover Kazan's one weakness, scouting and tracking. Tsume introduces herself first, loud and direct, and tells Kazan they are in this together. Shibi stays behind his sunglasses until she elbows him twice, and only then does he formally greet Kazan by his family name, Zhen. Tsume leads them into the exam room, and dozens of eyes snap onto them. More than sixty Genin fill the room. Kazan is, without contest, the youngest person in it. The next youngest team is a Cloud squad, and Kazan's eyes stop on the girl in it. His pupils shrink. That is Yugito Nii, the Two-Tails jinchuriki, and the Cloud actually spends its ultimate weapon on a Chunin Exam. They are going all in. Kazan runs the history in his head. At the first Five Kage Summit, Hashirama Senju captures eight Tailed Beasts, keeps only the strongest, the Nine-Tails, for Konoha, and hands the other seven out as proof of peace. The Cloud walks away with the Eight-Tails and the Two-Tails, and then never stops researching how to turn a Tailed Beast into a regular battlefield weapon. This generation, it works. Killer B masters the Eight-Tails completely and stands as only the second perfect jinchuriki in history after Madara Uchiha. Whether Yugito reaches that level, Kazan cannot tell. Inside Yugito, the Two-Tails, Matatabi, warns her to watch the Konoha kid, because he is already watching her. Yugito looks over, sees a Genin even younger than herself, and scoffs. If this is all Konoha sends, the Raikage worries for nothing. Matatabi insists anyway. No proof, only instinct, and the instinct says this kid is wrong somehow. Tsume leans in and asks Kazan if he has a crush on the Cloud girl. Kazan says yes, just not the kind she means, and then he warns his team seriously. If either of them ends up alone with that girl, they do not hesitate, they run. A jinchuriki who fully controls her beast fights at Kage level at minimum. Shinku already warns him the other villages plant bombs inside their teams. Kazan just never expects the bomb to be an actual nuke. The room falls silent as the first proctor walks in, Shikaku Nara, a pineapple-haired Nara in his early twenties. He skips every ceremony. Round one is a written exam. Pass the score line and you pass, with one condition. Every member of a team must pass, or the whole team goes home. Heads whip around as every squad silently identifies its weakest student. Cheating is the obvious answer, and Shikaku kills it in the next breath. He shuffles every seat so nobody sits near a teammate, and extra proctors file in along the walls. Get caught cheating, and you lose your qualification on the spot. Bro really locks the room down like a prison and then dares a room full of ninja to cheat anyway. Shibi and Tsume both ask Kazan if his classroom grades are any good. Kazan tells them not to worry, especially on survival topics. He also knows what this exam really tests. It never cares about the answers. It tests how a ninja collects intelligence and passes it along under watch. And Kazan prepares before he even walks in. Ten shadow clones already hide inside this building, searching for the answers, and he only has to wait for one to dispel and send the memories home. The exam begins, and the room fills with sharp inhales. The questions are absurd, built for top scholars, not working Genin. A few pens start flying and never stop, and Kazan's Observation Haki picks out exactly three of them. Their emotions sit far too calm for examinees. These are planted answer sources, placed here for sharp students to steal from. The sharp ones notice. Shibi sends his insects out, Tsume works through her dog Kuromaru, and answers start moving in a dozen invisible ways. Kazan sits still until the word lands in his head. Found it. In an office in this building, his clone memorizes the full answer key and dispels itself, and the memories pour straight back into the original. Kazan picks up his pen and writes like a man possessed. Shikaku watches him and finds nothing. No movement, no signal, no cheat he can name. Then his assistant whispers that someone ransacks the office where the answers hide, and the surveillance points at Yugito herself. The answer sheet there lies torn to shreds. Shikaku smiles instead of raging. A shadow clone exists for exactly this, gathering intelligence without risking the body, and Kazan uses it perfectly. Time expires, the grading takes under half an hour, and Shikaku reads the results. Kazan, Shibi Aburame and Tsume Inuzuka all pass. Tsume exhales and rubs Kuromaru's head while the dog squints in pure pleasure. Then the second proctor walks in, a senior named Mitarashi, and delivers one sentence that freezes the survivors. In round two, he eliminates more than half of what is left. Out of roughly forty students, only about twenty walk out of the next stage. The survivors gather in front of the Forest of Death, under the scar-faced proctor Moriaki Mitarashi. Sand and Cloud Genin immediately trade insults across the clearing, each promising to bury the other. Moriaki orders everyone forward to sign a consent form. Anyone who refuses can leave right now. The Cloud sign first and mock the Sand while the ink is still wet. Kazan signs without drama. Moriaki explains the rules. Every team receives either a Heaven scroll or an Earth scroll. Collect the matching partner scroll by any means necessary, reach the tower at the center of the forest, and you pass. Nobody may open a scroll, on pain of disqualification. The proctor says it with a grin that pulls at his scar. Yes, this round forces you to fight each other. The ninja world is cruel, so stop being naive. The teams enter in batches, and Kazan's squad moves the moment their turn comes. Kazan gives the order himself. Speed wins this round. Kuromaru's nose goes to work, Shibi releases a cloud of insects, and within moments the dog barks. One team, twelve o'clock, roughly one kilometer out. He tells his teammates to keep up and vanishes. Shave, one of the Six Powers, turns one step into a blur, and when Tsume blinks, Kazan already stands dozens of meters ahead. She realizes he has been matching their pace this whole time, and then a worse thought follows. This lunatic plans to take an entire enemy team by himself. Kazan reaches the target first. Three Sand ninja, and their caution melts the instant they see one lone kid with a Konoha headband. They decide to kill him here and hunt his teammates after. Kazan gives them one chance anyway. Hand over the scroll. Then he stomps a trunk apart, launches himself above all three, and cocks his right fist as chakra floods into it. He has no Armament Haki yet, so raw chakra does the job. The pressure on that fist turns all three faces pale at once. Fist Bone. Impact. The punch falls like a galaxy dropping out of the sky. The ground bursts open like tofu, and the shockwave hurls the whole Sand team away even though they dodge fast. One punch lands in her back, bones crack, and her body flies into a tree and drops like a puppet with its strings cut. One exchange, and the Sand team is down a member. The shockwave rolls back to Tsume and Shibi, and both of them curse and sprint harder. Kazan gives the survivors no time to breathe. He stomps forward and throws again. Fist Bone. Impact. One Sand ninja fails to get clear, and the fist punches clean through his chest, but the feel is wrong. No flesh, no blood. The body twists back into its true shape, a carefully built human puppet. The puppeteer drops in behind and above him, sneering that Kakashi or not, this kid dies today. Chakra threads spin from ten fingers into a second puppet, while the last Sand ninja weaves signs and fires a genjutsu, the Fox Mind technique. The forest folds into a maze around Kazan, his eyes go blank, and the blade-loaded puppet dives at every vital point on his body at once. A clean, practiced kill. Then a tiger's roar shakes the trees. Hakimi explodes out of the forest, and one airborne paw swats the puppeteer and his puppet out of the sky together. At the same instant, chakra erupts off Kazan so violently that the ground shatters, and the genjutsu maze shatters with it, torn apart by a pure chakra explosion. The genjutsu user stares in disbelief. The method works, but it wrecks the user's own body, and nobody in the ninja world fights like that. Kazan appears in front of him mid-stare. Losing focus in a fight is a terrible habit. One finger drives into the man's throat. Finger Pistol. Blood sprays out the back of his neck in a thin red line, and Paku dies still trying to warn his last teammate, with no sound left to warn him with. The last Sand ninja screams his name, and Hakimi pins him to the dirt with one huge paw while Kazan searches the bodies. Luck lands on Kazan's side. The Sand team's scroll is exactly the one his team needs. Tsume and Shibi arrive with Kuromaru, and all three stop short at the scene. Kazan stands before an enormous tiger, surrounded by Sand corpses and a cratered battlefield. Kuromaru's fur spikes up, teeth bared, and Hakimi stands guard behind Kazan until Kazan introduces him as his companion. The tiger relaxes, pleased with the title, and pushes his big head in for a rub. Tsume finally connects the dots out loud. So the lunatic who rides a tiger around the village is him. Kazan ignores the wound to his pride, swings up onto Hakimi's back, and orders the move. They hold the prize, so they ride straight for the central tower before delay invites trouble, because confident teams with no scrolls love ambushing finishers at the goal. On the ride, Tsume asks why Kazan moves through this forest like he owns the place. Kazan answers like he is stating the weather. This is his hunting ground. Tsume laughs, and then stops, because he means it literally. Other people fill up on one bowl of ramen. He needs dozens. So, to fill his stomach, he hunts in this forest from early childhood. Tsume's mind reels. Her own parents warn her as a little girl to never set foot in this forbidden place, and she only enters it now, more than a decade later, under exam rules. This kid treats it like his kitchen, which explains why walking in here feels like coming home for him. When she asks about the tiger, Kazan tells it plainly. Hakimi loses his mother as a newborn cub, survives by fleeing to the forest's edge, and runs into Kazan there. That is the whole story. Shibi finally speaks as the tower comes into view. They are here. Inside, the team hands over their Heaven and Earth scrolls, and the examiner confirms it on the spot. They pass the second round. Kazan refuses to waste four days sitting down. More than ten shadow clones split off and head out to train at the rear mountain. The original unpacks a sealing scroll and pulls out the weights Hiruzen prepares for him, a full set for his arms, his legs and his torso armor. Tsume picks one up out of curiosity and nearly drops it. The lightest piece runs at least a hundred kilograms, and the heaviest pushes toward five hundred. Kazan straps the full set on and still walks like the wind, and he insists, to her total disbelief, that he only starts wearing them recently. At that same hour, in the Hokage's office, Hiruzen works through the exam's real purpose. The Fire Daimyo is still five days out, his journey smooth apart from one bandit gang the Anbu escort erases without effort, and Hiruzen needs that meeting, because Konoha must convince the Daimyo to fund the war everyone in this room knows is coming. When Hiruzen asks about the exam, the report is already good. The second round is under way, and Kazan's team passes it. The Anbu reporting it calls him Lord Kazan without thinking, because everyone knows Kazan is Hiruzen's fourth student now, and given time, a top power of Konoha rises in him. Hiruzen dismisses the man, feeds chakra into his crystal ball, and watches Kazan training in the rest room with open satisfaction. Then a second Anbu drops in with a swish, kneels, and speaks in a tone that kills the mood in the room. The intelligence is verified, checked and confirmed. Among the Genin the Cloud sends into this exam sits the Two-Tails jinchuriki. Hiruzen's pupils contract. The Cloud, the most domineering of the five great villages, the one that never stops bleeding for its Tailed Beast research, fields a jinchuriki in a Chunin Exam. With Killer B standing as the second perfect jinchuriki in history after Madara himself, the conclusion writes itself. The Cloud has truly mastered it. They can field a Tailed Beast as a regular weapon of war.

China After Disaster | How People Rebuild Life After A Devastating Landslide | 4K Travel Documentary

After a devastating Himalayan landslide changed everything, the people of Nepal are facing one of the hardest journeys of their lives — rebuilding their homes, communities, and future from the ruins.

Deep in the mountains, where villages have existed for generations, a sudden natural disaster destroyed homes, damaged roads, and separated families. What was once a peaceful Himalayan landscape became a place of loss, uncertainty, and survival.

This cinematic 4K travel documentary takes you beyond the disaster to discover the human stories behind the tragedy — the families searching for hope, the communities coming together, and the people determined to rebuild the only home they have ever known.

From damaged mountain villages and recovery efforts to the strength of local people helping each other, this journey reveals how communities adapt and rise again after one of nature’s most powerful forces.

The Himalayas have always represented strength and endurance. For the people living beneath these mountains, resilience is not just a word — it is a way of life.

Experience Nepal after the disaster, where destruction meets determination, and where every rebuilt home carries a story of courage, hope, and survival.

Join Planet Unreal 4K on a cinematic journey into the world’s most extraordinary places, uncovering real human stories, powerful landscapes, and the incredible resilience of people around our planet.

EO0rsQeJQFk.transcript: Nepal 13 days after the disaster. It has been 13 days since that terrifying morning changed Nepal forever. 13 days since entire valleys were torn apart. Since roads and bridges disappeared beneath mud and shattered rock. And since thousands of families began waiting for loved ones who never came home. Today [music] beneath the Himalayas, a country known to the world for extraordinary beauty is living through grief on a scale few could have imagined. They are trying to reconstruct where people may have been when the landscape itself was transformed. But one of the most remarkable survival stories from that morning did not happen inside a tunnel at all. In Newokott, flood water was approaching a district prison located on low ground. Before it reached the compound, security personnel moved 923 prisoners [music] into a building at a higher elevation. The water later entered the lower prison area, but the decision to move them had [music] already placed hundreds of people beyond its immediate path. During the chaos, 50 prisoners broke through walls and gates and escaped as the flood approached. They did not get far. Authorities later recaptured them after they had fled only about 100 m. It is a strange detail inside an enormous tragedy, but it reveals how quickly ordinary rules disappeared when everyone, guards and prisoners alike, realized that the river was coming. Elsewhere, survival depended on decisions made within minutes. People climbed toward higher ground without knowing whether their homes would still exist when they returned. Workers searched for elevated [music] sections of buildings. Families abandoned possessions accumulated over decades because carrying them would have slowed their escape. [music] In disasters like this, the difference between survival and disappearance can sometimes be a single decision made before anyone fully understands the danger. Now, many of those survivors face an entirely different question. Where do you return when the place called home is no longer safe? Thousands of houses have [music] been destroyed or damaged and some families have been left without usable land. [music] Preliminary reporting also indicates extensive damage to hydro power facilities and other critical infrastructure, meaning [music] reconstruction will reach far beyond individual homes. For families who live beside these rivers for decades, relocation is not simply a matter of moving a house farther uphill. Their land may contain fields inherited from parents, shops built over a lifetime, neighbors who function almost like relatives, and places connected to births, marriages, and funerals. Leaving the danger behind may also mean leaving an entire personal history behind. That dilemma is beginning to define the next phase of Nepal's catastrophe. The emergency was about escaping the water. [music] The recovery will be about deciding which places can safely exist again. Some roads can be repaired. Bridges can be replaced. Electricity lines can be rebuilt. But rebuilding a community in exactly the same location may recreate the same vulnerability that existed before the flood. The economic consequences are also becoming clearer. An assessment reported by AP estimates damage at around $2.56 billion [music] while roughly 7,500 homes were destroyed and 12 hydro power projects were damaged. For Nepal, rebuilding will therefore become one of the largest tests facing the country's government long after international rescue teams eventually leave. But money cannot answer the question troubling thousands of families tonight. [music] A destroyed bridge has a location. Engineers can see where it stood and calculate what is needed [music] to replace it. A missing person leaves something far more difficult. Uncertainty. There is no place to rebuild, no structure to repair, only an empty space and the possibility that somewhere somehow an answer has not yet been found. That is why forensic teams are working alongside rescuers. Bodies that cannot immediately be identified are undergoing forensic procedures while relatives of missing people are being asked to provide DNA profiles. Specialists from India, China, Japan, Singapore, and South Korea have joined Nepali authorities in an identification effort that may continue long after active rescue operations end. For some families, DNA may eventually provide the answer they have been dreading. For others, [music] a tunnel opening could still provide the answer they desperately want. And between those two possibilities lies the crulest part of this disaster. Thousands of people remain suspended between mourning and hope. >> [music] >> Meanwhile, more than 3,500 displaced people [music] were still being sheltered across 39 holding centers in Rasua, Newot and Harding. According to Nepal's disaster authority, these places have become temporary communities filled with people who survived the same catastrophe but lost very different things. homes, businesses, relatives, farmland, [music] documents, or simply the feeling that the valley around them was safe. Children will eventually return to classrooms. Shops will reopen somewhere. Roads will once again carry buses through these valleys. The sound of construction will replace the sound of rescue machinery. From the outside, those changes may eventually look like recovery. But Nepal will remember what happened here differently. Because this disaster has exposed something that had remained largely invisible beneath the beauty of the Himalayas. An enormous network connecting [music] glacias, rivers, settlements, roads, power stations, and millions of people. Something can happen far above the inhabited valleys in a place almost nobody can see [music] and its consequences can travel downstream until they reach a family sitting inside an ordinary home. [music] And that raises a much larger question. Nepal cannot abandon the Himalayas. These mountains provide water, energy, farmland, tourism, and identity. Generations have built their lives around them. The challenge now is not learning how to live without the mountains, but understanding how people can continue living beneath them as the environment changes. >> [music] >> Perhaps that is where the real story of Nepal begins. Not with the moment the flood arrived, but with what happens when the water is gone. When the cameras leave. When survivors must return. And when thousands of people stand beneath the same mountains that shaped their lives, knowing they can never look at them in quite the same way again.

shelter indoors and stay away from the glass. Authorities issued typhoon and tropical storm

higher, threatening the coastline. The roar of the elements served as a reminder 
of their merciless power and unpredictability. The meteorological service described the 
typhoon as an "immediate threat to life." This typhoon has become a new 
challenge for a region that has not yet recovered from previous disasters.

2uu845py58c.title: "Massive" Chilcotin River landslide in BC could cause flash flooding in next 24 to 48 hours
2uu845py58c.description:
A huge landslide blocking the Chilcotin River in British Columbia has forced the evacuation of a dozen homes and prompted a flood warning from the site of the slide, down the Fraser River all the way to Hope. 

Emergency officials said the landslide is expected to cause flash flooding downstream when the river breaches the slide area.

On Tuesday, the Cariboo Regional District said the timeline of the breach is unknown but believe it could happen within the next 24 to 48 hours.

As Troy Charles reports, the warning is stark and the danger of a catastrophic flood is growing every hour.

पनि एक ठाउँबाट अर्को ठाउँमा जाने तयारीमा हुनुहुन्छ होला। अ यात्रा अत्यावश्यक नभए नगर्नु भनेर त प्रशासनले भनि नै रहेको छ। यस्तो वखतमा एउटा व्यक्तिले धादिङ चितवन लगायतका व्यक्तिहरुले सावधानी कसरी अपनाउनु पर्छ? >> अ पक्कै पनि रुपा जी यो निकै महत्वपूर्ण हो। मान्छेले एक ठाउँबाट अर्को ठाउँमा गएर नै आफ्नो जीविको चलाउनु पर्ने त्यसमाथि पनि अ हाम्रा ठुला चाडपर्वहरु नजिकि रहेका छन्। त्यो बेलामा विभिन्न कामका सिलसिलामा एक ठाउँबाट अर्को ठाउँमा रहेर बसिरहेका का नागरिकहरु आफ्नो गृह जिल्ला आफ्नो चाहिँ स्थायी बसोबास रहेको ठाउँमा जानका लागि यतिखेर धेरैले योजना बनाउन थाल्ने बेला भैकेको छ। त्यो सँै संघीय राजधानी काठमाडौलाई सामानहरु आयात गर्नका लागि पनि लामो समयसम्म यो सडक खण्ड बन्द भएको हुनाले पनि यतिखेर मालवाग सवारी साधनहरु काठमाडौँ भित्रिने क्रम पनि निकै बढी भएको बेला हो। यो बेलामा सडक खण्डमा यस्तो खालको जोखिम हुदा खेरि सवारी प्रयोगकर्ताहरुले विशेष गरि यो सडक खण्डमा सवारी प्रयोग गर्ने सवारी प्रयोगकर्ताहरुले सकेसम्म त अ यात्रा नगर्नुपर्ने कुरा नै महत्वपूर्ण रैहाल्यो। >> यद्यप यात्रा गर्नु नै पर्ने परिस्थिति रहदा खेरि पनि अहिले त अब आजको मितिमा हेर्ने हो भने त सडक पूर्ण रुपमा अवरुद्ध रहेको छ वैकल्पिक सडकहरु प्रयोग गर्नुपर्ने अवस्था रहेको छ। वैकल्पिक सडक प्रयोग गरिरहदा खेरि पनि देशभरको मौसम बिग्रिएको वर्षा भैरहेको हुनाले पनि अ यतिखेर यो बेलामा यात्रा गर्ने यात्रुहरुले पहिलो कुरा त आफुले यात्रा गर्ने सडक खण्डको कस्तो छ त्यो सडकको अवस्थाको बारेमा स्थानीय प्रहरी नजिकको सुरक्षाकर्मीहरुसँग हुनुहुन्छ भने पनि यो सडक खण्डमा मात्रै हैन देशभर जुनसुकै सडक खण्डमा यो बरसातको बेलामा यात्रा गर्ने सवारी प्रयोगकर्ताले आफ्ना लागि नभै नहुने जरुरी सामग्रीहरु हरु जस्तै आफुले नियमित प्रयोग गरिरहनुपर्ने 8M3VRda1OuE.description:
As Nigeria moves closer to the 2027 general election, attention is increasingly focused on the African Democratic Congress (ADC), its political direction and its role in the opposition’s plans.

In this interview, Alhaji Aliyu Audu discusses the ADC, the political calculations ahead of 2027, the challenges facing the opposition and the issues that could shape the next presidential election.

What does the ADC hope to achieve in 2027? What are the party’s prospects, and what should Nigerians expect from the unfolding political realignments?

Watch the full interview and join the conversation. Share your thoughts in the comments.

Критично и во тетовското село Шипковица, каде поради настанато слечиште четири семејства ги напуштија своите домови. Директно се загрозени нивните четири куќи. Овие тетовчани нема да се вратат во своите домови се додека властите не проценат дека нема опасност. Габриела Лескова, Сител телевизија. ።
